text: My main symptom is Weakness and fatigue. I also have Mild diplopia.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. The combination of progressive weakness/fatigue and mild diplopia, particularly after exertion and outdoor activities, strongly points to a neuromuscular junction disorder. Please confirm if your symptoms worsen later in the day or with activity. I am requesting antibody testing for Anti-AChR and Anti-MuSK, along with a Chest CT to evaluate for thymoma. REQUEST TEST: Anti-AChR Antibodies, Anti-MuSK Antibodies, Chest_CT; REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_CT.
